title: createAlibabaCompatibleProvider returns a provider object
steps: Assert the return value is defined
expected_result: Provider object is returned without error

title: createAlibabaCompatibleProvider returns a callable (function) provider
expected_result: @ai-sdk/alibaba providers are callable functions

title: provider(modelId) returns a language model with correct modelId
expected_result: The language model object reflects the requested modelId

title: Model object has provider string containing 'alibaba'
expected_result: Provider identity confirms alibaba routing, not openai
notes: Critical: ensures web models don't accidentally route through openai

title: Web provider instance is distinct from OpenAI-compatible provider
test_data: Same baseURL and apiKey for both providers
steps: Create alibaba provider for web models
expected_result: The two providers are completely independent; alibaba is used for web, openai for others

title: createAlibabaCompatibleProvider returns a fresh instance per call (no caching)
steps: Call createAlibabaCompatibleProvider twice with identical options
expected_result: Unlike copilot provider, alibaba provider is not cached

title: Model has specificationVersion === 'v1'
expected_result: AI SDK v1 specification version confirmed

title: Provider sends request to proxy with correct path and Authorization header
preconditions: Bun.serve available for local test server
test_data: apiKey: proxy-api-key, fake SSE response from local server
steps: Spin up a local Bun.serve server that responds with valid SSE chunks
Create alibaba provider pointing at the local server
Call generateText with the provider model
Assert the server received a request at /v1/chat/completions
Assert result.text contains the expected text from the fake response
expected_result: Provider correctly sends OpenAI-compatible chat completions request with Bearer auth
notes: Also validates that delta.reasoning_content in SSE does not break text extraction

title: Various web model IDs are passed through unchanged to alibaba provider
steps: For each model ID, call provider(modelId)
expected_result: Model IDs are not mutated by the provider creation

title: ProviderRegistry.register adds provider to internal list
expected_result: Provider is registered

title: authenticate_all sets _ready=True on successful provider
steps: Create registry and register a provider that returns True from authenticate()
expected_result: Ready flag is set

title: authenticate_all sets _ready=False on failed provider
steps: Register a provider that returns False from authenticate()
expected_result: Provider is marked unavailable but server continues

title: authenticate_all handles provider exceptions without crashing
test_data: FakeProvider that raises RuntimeError in authenticate()
steps: Register a provider that raises an exception in authenticate()
expected_result: Authentication failure is caught; other providers continue
notes: Critical: one broken provider must not crash the proxy startup

title: resolve() returns the first ready provider that handles the model
steps: Register a ready FakeProvider with handles_prefix='qwen'
expected_result: Correct provider is returned

title: resolve() returns None when no provider handles the model
test_data: Ready qwen provider, querying for claude model
expected_result: None returned when no match

title: resolve() falls back to inactive provider for better error messages
steps: Register a provider with _ready=False that handles 'qwen3'
Assert result is the inactive provider (not None)
expected_result: Inactive provider returned so server can give a clear 503 error

title: all_models() returns models from ready providers only
steps: Assert only ready provider's models are included
expected_result: Inactive provider models excluded from /v1/models

title: sse_text produces valid SSE bytes with correct OpenAI chunk structure
steps: Assert return is bytes ending in \n\n
Parse the data line as JSON
expected_result: Valid OpenAI SSE chunk with text delta

title: sse_reasoning produces delta.reasoning_content field
steps: Parse the data line as JSON
expected_result: Reasoning chunk emits reasoning_content, not content
notes: Critical: @ai-sdk/alibaba maps reasoning_content to reasoning events

title: sse_tool_call_start produces correct tool_calls array
steps: Call sse_tool_call_start with the given params
Parse the data line as JSON
expected_result: Valid tool_call start chunk matching OpenAI streaming spec

title: sse_tool_call_args produces incremental arguments chunk
expected_result: Args-only chunk matches OpenAI incremental tool_calls spec

title: sse_finish produces finish chunk with empty delta and correct reason
expected_result: Valid finish chunk for both stop and tool_calls reasons

title: non_stream_response builds correct non-streaming response for text-only
test_data: text='hello world', no tools, no reasoning
expected_result: Clean text-only non-streaming response

title: non_stream_response includes tool_calls and sets finish_reason=tool_calls
steps: Assert choices[0].message.tool_calls equals the input list
expected_result: Tool-calling response has correct finish_reason and tool_calls

title: non_stream_response includes reasoning_content when provided
expected_result: Reasoning content is preserved in non-streaming response

title: build_tool_preamble returns empty string for empty tools list
expected_result: No preamble injected when no tools

title: build_tool_preamble includes tool name, description, and parameters
test_data: type=function tool with name, description, parameters
steps: Call build_tool_preamble with an OpenAI-format function tool
Assert tool name appears in result
Assert parameters JSON appears in result
Assert <tool_call> tag format instruction is present
expected_result: Preamble provides complete tool documentation

title: messages_to_prompt correctly serialises all four message roles
test_data: Messages with system, user, assistant, tool roles
steps: Build a message list with all four roles
expected_result: All roles serialised with correct prefixes

title: messages_to_prompt serialises assistant tool_calls as <tool_call> XML
steps: Create assistant message with tool_calls=[{function:{name, arguments}}]
Assert tool name appears in output
expected_result: Tool call history is correctly round-tripped into prompt

title: messages_to_prompt injects tool preamble into system message
steps: Call messages_to_prompt with tools and a system message
Assert preamble appears before the system content in the output
expected_result: Tool preamble prepended to system message

title: ToolCallParser.feed parses a single complete <tool_call> block
expected_result: Tool call parsed correctly

title: ToolCallParser.feed correctly accumulates a tool_call split across multiple chunks
test_data: tool_call block split at midpoint into two feed() calls
steps: Feed first half of the tool_call block
Collect all events from both calls
expected_result: Streaming parser correctly reassembles split tool_call blocks
notes: Key scenario: LLM streams tokens one at a time

title: ToolCallParser.feed emits text event for invalid JSON inside <tool_call>
steps: Feed invalid JSON in tool_call tags
Assert a ('text', ...) event is emitted with the raw content
expected_result: Invalid JSON gracefully falls back to text without crashing

title: ToolCallParser.flush emits partial open tag as text
test_data: Feed '<tool_call>{"name":' without closing tag, then flush
steps: Assert a text event is emitted containing <tool_call>
expected_result: Partial tag is recovered as text on stream end

title: ToolCallParser.flush resets internal state for reuse
test_data: Feed text, flush, then feed a complete tool_call
expected_result: Parser state is clean after flush

title: load_token_file returns token from environment variable
expected_result: Env var takes priority, returns the token

title: Env var takes priority over token file when both are present
test_data: Token file with 'file-secret', env var with 'env-wins'
expected_result: Env var wins over file

title: load_token_file reads token from JSON file when env var absent
steps: Write token file in temp dir
expected_result: Token loaded from file

title: load_token_file raises RuntimeError when neither env var nor file exists
steps: Point CONFIG_DIR to empty temp dir
Assert error message mentions env var name
expected_result: Clear RuntimeError with guidance on how to fix

title: load_token_file raises RuntimeError when token file contains invalid JSON
test_data: Token file with 'this is not json'
steps: Write a file with invalid JSON content
expected_result: Malformed file treated as missing

title: load_token_file raises RuntimeError when JSON file lacks the expected key
expected_result: Missing key treated as missing token

title: load_token_file raises RuntimeError when token file value is empty string
steps: Write token file with empty string value
expected_result: Empty string is not a valid token
